Play is the prize. 🤍

Some days are simply meant to be remembered.

The kind where children run without worrying about how fast they are, try without worrying about getting it right, and laugh a little louder because everyone they love is there.

Our first Sports Day was one of those days.

A day for children to discover what their bodies can do, to cheer for their friends, to keep trying and to enjoy being in the moment.

And for parents, perhaps, a chance to see their little ones in a new way. To watch them grow, take a leap, stumble, try again and find joy in something as simple as play.

If there was one thing we wanted our first Sports Day to leave behind, it was this:

The joy of playing is worth more than the joy of winning.

And that is why, at Eravoo, play is the prize. 

#Eravoo #sportsday #preschool #kids #playbased

A language can be spoken.
A language can be signed.
A language can be expressed through movement, gesture and expression.

This International Sign Language Day and European Day of Languages, we’re celebrating the many ways children can discover communication. From the sounds of Spanish and French to the visual language of signs, each one offers a different way to listen, express and connect.

And the more ways they discover, the wider their little world becomes.

Eravoo tumbled headfirst into a magnificent universe of dots!

Dots as far as your eyes can see .They danced playfully on our socks, peeked out from our clothes, frosted our classroom windows, and spilled masterfully across our wet-ink canvases. And why stop at the walls? 

Our adventurous spirits followed those dots right past the classroom door, sailing all the way out into the swirling, mysterious black holes of the universe.

What happens when you give little hands a wall, some paint, and the freedom to create?

They explore. They experiment. They get messy. And most importantly, they have fun while learning.

At Eravoo, Messy Play is not about creating something perfect. It is about letting children experience colours, textures and movement in their own way. There are no right strokes, no perfect patterns and no worrying about staying inside the lines.

Sometimes, the best way to learn is to get your hands dirty, make a little mess and see where your imagination takes you.

Some of the most beautiful childhood memories are made in the company of grandparents.

Their stories spark imagination.
Their hugs bring comfort.

And their love gives children the confidence to explore the world.
